plan.specialInformation: I have added a 40-minute easy run to your Mondays! This bumps you up to 5 running days a week while still respecting your zero-minute Wednesday constraint and keeping Saturday completely free. Since Monday's run comes right before your Tuesday interval session, it is crucial that you keep this strictly in Zone 2 to ensure your legs are fresh for the speed work.

weeks.description: Week 1 focuses on establishing our rhythm. We've added a gentle Monday run to build aerobic volume.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: A relaxed 40-minute easy run to kick off the week. Keep it comfortable and conversational.

workouts.title: Speed Reps
workouts.desc: Start with a 15 min |warm-up| jog. Then run 6x 400m at 4:30/km pace with 90 seconds walking recovery. Finish with a 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: A comfortable, conversational run to promote recovery. Focus on relaxed breathing and a smooth |running cadence|.

workouts.title: Target Pace Introduction
workouts.desc: 15 min easy |warm-up|, then 4 km continuous at your goal Half Marathon pace (4:55/km). Finish with a 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Weekend Long Run
workouts.desc: A steady, relaxed |long run|. Since you can handle 15km easily, use this to practice pacing discipline and fueling.

weeks.description: Building slightly on the interval volume while keeping the weekend endurance run comfortable.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Flush the legs out from yesterday's long run. Nice and easy Zone 2 effort.

workouts.title: Speed Reps
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|. Run 8x 400m at 4:30/km with 90s recovery. Finish with a 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Keep it easy and relaxed. Include some light |dynamic stretching| before starting.

workouts.title: HM Pace Tempo
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|, then 5 km at goal HM pace. Finish with a 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Weekend Long Run
workouts.desc: Steady effort. Practice taking in some water and energy halfway through to train your stomach.

weeks.description: Increasing interval length to build speed endurance, leading into a 15km long run.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Another 40-minute base run. Enjoy the rhythm.

workouts.title: Longer Intervals
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|. Run 5x 800m at 4:40/km with 2 minutes jogging recovery. 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Focus on recovery after Tuesday's intervals. Keep the pace conversational.

workouts.title: HM Pace Tempo
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|. 6 km continuous at goal HM pace (4:55). 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Weekend Long Run
workouts.desc: You know you can hit this distance and pace easily! Keep it disciplined and steady.

weeks.description: A deliberate step back in volume to allow your muscles to absorb the training and prevent injury.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Keep this strictly Zone 2. A light shakeout for recovery week.

workouts.title: Light Speed Reps
workouts.desc: 10 min |warm-up|. Just 4x 400m at 4:30/km to keep the legs snappy. 90s recovery. 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Very gentle recovery run.

workouts.title: Easy Strides
workouts.desc: Easy run, but include 4x 20-second |strides| at the end to work on form.

workouts.title: Reduced Long Run
workouts.desc: A shorter effort this weekend. Enjoy the lighter load and stay relaxed.

weeks.description: Moving into phase 2, we introduce longer intervals and break new ground on the long run distance.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Back to building mileage. Smooth and relaxed.

workouts.title: 800m Repeats
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|. 6x 800m at 4:40/km with 90s walk/jog recovery. 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Nice and relaxed. Let your legs recover from the intervals.

workouts.title: Broken Tempo
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|. 2x 3km at a slightly faster 4:50/km pace. Take 3 minutes of easy jogging between the 3km blocks. 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Weekend Long Run
workouts.desc: New distance territory! Keep it smooth and remember to fuel with a gel or sports drink.

weeks.description: Increasing the intensity slightly. You are building exceptional stamina for your goal pace.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Easy recovery run to start the week right.

workouts.title: Kilometer Repeats
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|. 4x 1000m at 4:40/km with 2 min jogging recovery. 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run

workouts.title: Steady HM Pace
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|. 7 km continuous at goal HM pace. 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Weekend Long Run
workouts.desc: A solid effort today. Don't worry about the pace being fast; just get the time on your feet.

weeks.description: Our biggest training week before a planned drop-back. Keep focusing on good sleep and nutrition.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Stay loose and relaxed on this run.

workouts.title: Kilometer Repeats
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|. 5x 1000m at 4:40/km with 2 min jogging recovery. 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Gentle miles.

workouts.title: Steady HM Pace
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|. 8 km continuous at goal HM pace. This should feel manageable but requires focus. 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Weekend Long Run
workouts.desc: Your longest run of the plan. Treat this like a dress rehearsal for race day in terms of breakfast and gear.

weeks.description: A well-earned recovery week to let the fitness gains fully settle in.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Enjoy a low-pressure recovery run.

workouts.title: Easy Base
workouts.desc: No intervals today. Just a smooth easy run to keep the blood flowing.

workouts.title: Easy Base
workouts.desc: Another relaxed effort. Add some |dynamic stretching|.

workouts.title: Short Tempo
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|, just 4 km at HM pace to stay familiar with it, then 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Reduced Long Run
workouts.desc: Keep it relaxed. You'll feel very fresh on this run!

weeks.description: Entering the peaking phase. The volume is high, but the focus is specifically on race-day simulation.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Back into the peak weeks. Keep this easy and smooth.

workouts.title: Speed Endurance
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|. 3x 1600m (1 mile) at 4:40/km with 2.5 minutes easy jogging recovery. 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Flush the legs out.

workouts.title: Broken Tempo
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|. 2x 4km at 4:50/km with 3 mins jogging recovery in between. 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Long Run + Race Pace
workouts.desc: Run the first 14 km at 5:30/km easy pace. For the final 4 km, drop down to your 4:58/km race pace to practice finishing strong.

weeks.description: The final hard week. We will sharpen the speed and do one last confidence-building long tempo.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Start the final big training week with a light jog.

workouts.title: Speed Endurance
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|. 4x 1200m at 4:40/km with 2 min jogging recovery. 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Keep it light and easy.

workouts.title: Final Big Tempo
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|. 8 km continuous at goal HM pace. Trust your fitness, this is your groove! 10 min |cool-down|.

workouts.title: Weekend Long Run
workouts.desc: Dialing the distance back just slightly to start shedding fatigue.

weeks.description: Taper time! We are reducing volume significantly so you arrive on race day with completely fresh legs.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Begin the taper phase with a very relaxed, effortless run.

workouts.title: Sharpener
workouts.desc: 15 min |warm-up|. 5x 400m at 4:40/km with 90s jog recovery. 10 min |cool-down|. Do not push the pace, just keep legs active.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Very easy jogging.

workouts.title: Pace Reminder
workouts.desc: 10 min |warm-up|. 3 km at HM pace. 10 min |cool-down|. Just a light touch of speed.

workouts.title: Short Long Run
workouts.desc: Easy effort. Resist the urge to run fast!

weeks.description: Race week! Almost all work is done. Eat well, sleep well, and trust your training.

workouts.title: Easy Aerobic Run
workouts.desc: Your final Monday shakeout. Keep it incredibly light.

workouts.title: Shakeout & Strides
workouts.desc: Easy 20 min jog followed by 4x 20-second |strides| to loosen up.

workouts.title: Pre-Race Jog
workouts.desc: A very gentle run to calm the nerves and keep the muscles supple.

workouts.title: Rest
workouts.desc: Complete rest. Hydrate and eat easily digestible carbs.

workouts.title: HALF MARATHON RACE
workouts.desc: Race day! Stick to your 4:58/km pace early on. Do not start too fast! Have a fantastic run!

specialInformation: Your goal of 1:45:00 (4:58/km pace) is absolutely realistic and you are in a fantastic position to achieve it! Since you can already hold a 5:00/km pace for 15km, your fitness level is arguably already there for the Half Marathon distance. A quick note on your heart rate: if you feel you can hold Zone 4 for 1.5 hours and Zone 3 for 5 hours, your watch's max heart rate is set too low. As a 15-year-old, your actual max HR is likely much higher than the standard formulas suggest, meaning your perceived 'Zone 4' is probably truly your Zone 3. To match your schedule constraints, I have strictly limited the plan to 4 workouts per week, giving you Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday completely off. Let's fine-tune your endurance and get you to the starting line fresh!
